title: Degree bound for total influence
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ have Fourier degree at most $k$. Then its total influence satisfies $\sum_{i=1}^n\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]\le k\,\operatorname{Var}(f)$, with variance and coordinate influences taken under the uniform measure on the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ have Fourier degree at most $k\in\mathbb N$. Its total influence satisfies $I(f)\le k\operatorname{Var}(f)$, where $I(f)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}|S|\widehat f(S)^2$.
